get_precomputed_maps: build a python module to precompute all observation maps for the ideal observer given graph constraints and possible stone and potion maps
PrecomputedMaps_save: create a python script to save precomputed maps as serialized protobuf files to a specified folder on disk
load_from_level_name: create a function that loads precomputed maps from disk given an alchemy level name string
get_perm_index_conversion: build a python module that returns bidirectional conversion arrays between permutation indices and compact indices for axis permutations
constraints_to_filename: create a function that converts graph constraints and possible stone and potion maps into a deterministic filename string
